from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, colorsys

im = Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(float)
W = a.shape[1]
colmean = a.mean(axis=0)
lum = colmean @ np.array([0.2126,0.7152,0.0722])

# classify each column hue
def classify(rgb):
    r,g,b = rgb/255.0
    h,s,v = colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(r,g,b)
    if v < 0.18: return 'black'
    if s < 0.12:
        return 'gray'
    deg = h*360
    if deg < 20 or deg >= 340: return 'red'
    if deg < 50: return 'orange/warm'
    if deg < 70: return 'yellow'
    if deg < 160: return 'green'
    if deg < 200: return 'teal'
    if deg < 260: return 'blue'
    if deg < 300: return 'purple'
    return 'pink/red'

from collections import Counter
labels = [classify(c) for c in colmean]
print('hue distribution over all columns:')
for k,v in Counter(labels).most_common(): print(f'  {k}: {v} ({v/W*100:.1f}%)')

# brightest 15 columns
order = np.argsort(lum)[::-1]
print('\nbrightest columns (x, lum, RGB):')
seen=[]
for x in order:
    if lum[x] > 100:
        seen.append(x)
print('columns >100 lum:', len(seen))
top = sorted(order[:15])
for x in top:
    print(f'  x={x:4d} lum={lum[x]:5.1f} RGB=({colmean[x][0]:.0f},{colmean[x][1]:.0f},{colmean[x][2]:.0f}) {labels[x]}')

# most saturated columns
mx = colmean.max(axis=1); mn = colmean.min(axis=1)
sat = (mx-mn)/np.maximum(mx,1)
order2 = np.argsort(sat)[::-1]
print('\nmost saturated columns:')
for x in sorted(order2[:15]):
    print(f'  x={x:4d} sat={sat[x]:.2f} lum={lum[x]:5.1f} RGB=({colmean[x][0]:.0f},{colmean[x][1]:.0f},{colmean[x][2]:.0f}) {labels[x]}')

# teal/blue columns locations (G or B > R notably)
cool = [x for x in range(W) if colmean[x][2] > colmean[x][0]+8 or (colmean[x][1] > colmean[x][0]+8 and colmean[x][1] > colmean[x][2])]
def ranges(xs, gap=3):
    out=[]; 
    for x in xs:
        if out and x-out[-1][1]<=gap: out[-1][1]=x
        else: out.append([x,x])
    return out
r = ranges(cool)
print('\ncool (teal/blue/green-tinted) column ranges (as % of width):')
print([(round(s/W*100,1), round(e/W*100,1)) for s,e in r][:40])

# brightness over quarters and tenths
print('\nmean lum per tenth:')
for i in range(10):
    s,e = W*i//10, W*(i+1)//10
    print(f'  {i*10}-{(i+1)*10}%: {lum[s:e].mean():.1f}')
EOF

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json, re

def yt_search(q, n=8):
    url='https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query='+urllib.parse.quote(q)+'&sp=EgIQAQ%253D%253D'  # video filter
    html=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers=UA),timeout=25).read().decode('utf-8','ignore')
    out=[]
    for chunk in html.split('"videoRenderer":')[1:]:
        vid=re.match(r'\{"videoId":"([\w-]{11})"',chunk)
        t=re.search(r'"title":\{"runs":\[\{"text":"(.*?)"\}\]',chunk)
        d=re.search(r'"lengthText":\{.*?"text":"([\d:]+)"',chunk)
        if vid and t:
            out.append((vid.group(1), t.group(1), d.group(1) if d else '?'))
        if len(out)>=n: break
    return out

def player(vid):
    body={"context":{"client":{"clientName":"WEB","clientVersion":"2.20240702.01.00","hl":"en"}},"videoId":vid}
    req=urllib.request.Request('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?key=AIzaSyAO_FJ2Emq2kc1TYqAtEH1MgBEz3cgxuBo',data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Content-Type':'application/json'})
    resp=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=25).read())
    st=resp.get('playabilityStatus',{}).get('status')
    spec=resp.get('storyboards',{}).get('playerStoryboardSpecRenderer',{}).get('spec','')
    dur=resp.get('videoDetails',{}).get('lengthSeconds','')
    return st, spec, dur

 'A':'Detachment 2011 trailer',

 'D':'Brain on Fire 2016 trailer',
 'E':'I Frankenstein 2014 trailer',

 'I':'Candy 2006 trailer',
 'J':'Puncture 2011 trailer Chris Evans',
}
picked={}
for k,q in queries.items():
    print('==',k,q)
    got=None
    for vid,t,dur in yt_search(q):
        st,spec,d2=player(vid)
        ok = st=='OK' and spec
        print(f'   {vid} [{dur}] {t[:60]:60s} {st} spec={"Y" if spec else "-"}')
        if ok and got is None: got=(vid,t,d2,spec)
    picked[k]=got
json.dump({k:(v[0],v[1],v[2],v[3]) if v else None for k,v in picked.items()}, open('picked.json','w'))
print('\nPLAYABLE WITH SPEC:')
for k,v in picked.items(): print(k, v[0] if v else None, v[1][:50] if v else '')
EOF

    for seg in parts[1:]:

    base,lvls=parse_spec(spec)
    lv=lvls[-1]; L=str(len(lvls))
    nsheets=math.ceil(lv['total']/(lv['cols']*lv['rows']))
    urls=[base.replace('$L',L).replace('$N',lv['name'].replace('$M',str(s)))+'&sigh='+lv['sigh'] for s in range(nsheets)]
    imgs={}
    def dl(u):
        try: return u, np.asarray(Image.open(io.BytesIO(fetch(u))).convert('RGB'))

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex:

    if d<70: return 'yellow'
    if d<160: return 'green'
    if d<200: return 'teal'
    if d<260: return 'blue'
    if d<300: return 'purple'
    return 'pink'

                sat=float(sat.mean()),hues={c:round(v/n,3) for c,v in lab.most_common()})
    h=' '.join(f'{c}:{v:.2f}' for c,v in lab.most_common(6))
    print(f"{k} {d[k][0]} n={n:3d} lum={lum.mean():5.1f} med={np.median(lum):5.1f} <40:{(lum<40).mean():.2f} <60:{(lum<60).mean():.2f} >150:{(lum>150).mean():.2f} sat={sat.mean():.2f} | {h}")

print()
